name: Verify failure or outage is classified as Incident
objective: Validate that when a user describes a failure, outage, or system malfunction, the assistant correctly classifies the request as an Incident.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Describe a system failure or outage
steps.testData: "The CRM application is down and I cannot access any records"
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant classifies the request as an Incident
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies this as an Incident (not a Service Request)

steps.description: Verify the proposed ticket type is displayed to the user
steps.expectedResult: The assistant communicates the classification as 'Incident' before proceeding
